youtube.baslik: Can we recognize a melody played with very high tones? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Melodies played with tones above about 5 kilohertz are hard to recognize; the sense of musical pitch weakens. The frequency difference limen also grows clearly above 4 to 5 kilohertz, where phase locking of auditory nerve fibers fades. These findings suggest that timing information is important for fine pitch perception.
